lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Rb8Bi4Br24 (reduced formula KRb2BiBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Bi and K centers, each coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Br neighbors; the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Bi and K octahedra, plus face-sharing between K octahedra and Rb 12-vertex polyhedra.
